conservative_future_architecture.continuous_branch: small fully connected encoder over values concatenated with missing mask
conservative_future_architecture.fusion: concatenate branches before compact bottleneck and symmetric reconstruction heads
conservative_future_architecture.transport_extension: excluded from baseline; requires a later preregistered amendment to enter a model

evaluation_tracks.cross_dataset_ood: future P16 only; never mixed with LOAFO claims

fold_local_preprocessing.categorical: fixed protocol vocabulary; no labels, target rows or external rows used
fold_local_preprocessing.continuous: RobustScaler-like median/IQR transform fit on development-training identities only and observed values only
fold_local_preprocessing.masked_numeric_fill: 0.0 after transform with mask retained as a separate input

inputs.continuous_missing_mask: bool[batch,18], true exactly where semantic value is null
